gameDescriptionHtml:
Embark on a relentless quest to reclaim the wilds. Dinosaurs Dominion is built around action based combat, story driven exploration, and layered progression. Inspired by roguelite design, each journey is self-contained where progress is earned through both exploration and conquest, while lasting impacts carry over between runs.

FIGHT AND CONQUER – Face off in personal, high-stakes, one on one combat, a test of timing, spacing, and skill. Every fight rewards patience, punishes recklessness, and demands vigilance as you wait for your moment to strike.

EXPLORE AND DISCOVER – Roam freely across diverse biomes. From lush forests to ashen wastes and snow covered cliffs. Uncover secrets, discover ancient landmarks, and unlock new species along the way. Each region tells its own story, and every step brings you closer to reclaiming the wild.

ADAPT AND EVOLVE – Unlock mutations that suit your playstyle and sharpen your instincts with each victory, while defeat returns you to the start.

Game Features

  • 14 playable dinosaurs, from nimble scouts to towering juggernauts, each with a playstyle defined by size, power, and mobility.
  • 13 mutations that let you evolve, specialize, and experiment.
  • 3 open-world maps, each with unique biomes and environmental storytelling.
  • Focused one on one combat inspired by Souls-like design.
  • Roguelite progression with single-run challenges and permanent impact across journeys.
  • Landmarks, Relics, and Echoes that reward exploration with meaningful discoveries.
  • Totems and Trophies, unlockable rewards that reveal deeper insights into the world.
